pr_title: c2c: clean up stream ingestion completion on resume
pr_body:
This patch ensures that the stream ingestion job completes properly on
resumption after the user established a cutover timestamp while the job was
paused.

Fixes https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/102158

Release note: none

issue_context.title: c2c: post resume cutover does not properly clean up ingestion job
issue_context.body:
If the client initiates the cutover process during a paused stream ingestion job, on resume, the ingestion job does not get properly cleaned up. On resume, [we currently ](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/42973c22a1d923ea0bf0c5bb53c34df5a1f22948/pkg/ccl/streamingccl/streamingest/stream_ingestion_job.go#L245)only revert the timestamp, but we do not clean up protected timestamps, activate the dst tenant, or complete the producer job. In other words, on resume, we ought to instead conditionally call [completeIngestion() ](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/42973c22a1d923ea0bf0c5bb53c34df5a1f22948/pkg/ccl/streamingccl/streamingest/stream_ingestion_job.go#L193) instead. 


Jira issue: CRDB-27314

review_comments: q: how come we didn't completeIngestion here before? why is this different with your change?

> how come we didn't completeIngestion here before? 

because, as far as i could tell, we had a nasty bug before where didn't actually complete the ingestion job properly, hence this PR! In other words, whenever we revert, we must also do cleanup.
